title: Admin stress day surfaces the grant thread
description: Mara has completed sessions 1–3 across 6 weeks. In session 1 she mentioned the Cascadia Craft Fellowship grant unprompted. In session 2 she submitted the application. In session 3 she learned she got it. Now, still in session 3, she says she's buried in admin work on a frustrating day. The companion should connect the current admin stress to the specific grant paperwork she is doing — surface the thread in a way that could only come from knowing her history. Generic encouragement is not enough.
pass_proves: The system surfaces a specific stored thread at the moment it is emotionally and contextually relevant — not by announcing recall, but by connecting the current moment to the named specific.
fail_reveals: The system either misses the thread entirely (generic encouragement) or surfaces it at the wrong level (vague reference to 'your work' rather than the specific grant).
why_naive_fails: Retrieve-then-speak returns session summaries but cannot connect the admin stress to the specific grant paperwork without understanding the thread's context and current relevance.
